title: Trickle Imax: spec 09 14.1 says 17 min (1020 s), all stacks and vectors use 1024 s
description: Spec 09 14.1 R-09-007 divergence. Spec table: Imax = 17 minutes = 1020 s. All three implementations: Rust LICHEN_TRICKLE_IMAX_DOUBLINGS=8 -> LICHEN_TRICKLE_IMAX_MS=1_024_000 (rust/lichen-rpl/src/trickle.rs:7-13); C LICHEN_RPL_TRICKLE_IMAX_MS 1024000U (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/include/lichen/rpl_trickle.h:23); Python TRICKLE_IMAX_EXACT_MS==1_024_000 (python/src/lichen/timing/trickle.py:22,40, oracle docstring says Imax=17min approx 1_024_000 ms). Canonical vector packets-timing.json trickle_constants pins 1024 s. Imin=4 s and k=10 match exactly. Options: (a) amend spec table to 1024 s / 17.07 min (Imin 4 s x 2^8 doublings) and record in spec/decisions.jsonl - matches all implementations and vectors, recommended; (b) change all stacks + vectors to 1020 s (breaks trickle_constants). Needs human adjudication before either.
